image_description: A large, complex radio telescope structure situated in a grassy field under an overcast sky. The main feature is a massive parabolic dish antenna with a distinctive open-lattice steel backing structure and a solid white reflective surface. To the left, a tall support tower with cables (likely part of the elevation drive or a separate support mechanism) extends upwards. In the foreground, there is a dirt path, green grass, and some shrubbery. Small white buildings are visible in the mid-ground.
